description: Human issues an ambiguous help request with no explicit target object. Multiple candidates are visible. Robot must not hallucinate an action — it should ask for clarification.

expected.note: No explicit object → _is_query_intent()=False but LLMDecisionEngine sees ambiguity → ask_human

llm_decision.clarification_text: 你需要我拿支架還是扳手？

expected.robot_verbal_output: 你需要我拿支架還是扳手？

evaluation_criteria.routing_correct: must reach execute_task() → LLMDecisionEngine → ask_human branch
evaluation_criteria.no_hallucination: robot must NOT attempt pickup when intent is ambiguous
evaluation_criteria.clarification_specific: clarification_text must reference the candidate objects (bracket / hex_wrench)
evaluation_criteria.thesis_relevance: Demonstrates ASK policy: robot avoids hallucination when intent is ambiguous, requests minimal human clarification

thesis_claim: When human intent is ambiguous and multiple candidate objects exist, the robot refrains from guessing and requests targeted clarification.
